## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Pricing and paywall.**
      9 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Aug 27, 2026 - Sep 1, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Tr73ttt_, Sep 1, 2026, 1/5: "Every time they update this pathetic app they mess up paid subscriptions and try to get you to purchase them again!! My paid premium subscription is valid until May 2027 but when I go to use it the app says I need to pay for premium again!! Apple Store needs to delete them from the site !!"
            2. _Maddy793727_, Aug 31, 2026, 2/5: "Agreed that the newest update is horrible. There a small banner ad when you go to search for foods - it prevents you from scrolling down for st least 10-15 seconds, it’s just ridiculous. Beyond that, I hadn’t updated in a while and I see they removed the barcode scanner and made it for premium only. Very annoying. After you search and log a food why don’t you auto clear the search bar so I can quickly add the next food?"
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      5 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jun 18, 2026 - Aug 30, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Nickbarc_, Aug 28, 2026, 1/5: "App was good years before when I used it …now freezes ever second even after I updated it"
            2. _Verczeska_, Aug 24, 2026, 1/5: "I have been a user since early 2010s. I loved it and I recommended it to all friends, family and clients. The new update made it all unusable, I find it hard to see what I actually consumed. Bring the old version back."
            3. _Jen,seeking resolution_, Aug 17, 2026, 1/5: "Terrible navigation, continually have Mondays entries end up on the following Sunday, no longer is there mass delete, various editing functions gone, way more clicks to add and delete, hideous UI and UX, glitchy. Did anyone bother to even do a feature gap analysis before deploying this junk that has had nothing but terrible reviews none of which have they remedied or even addressed? Boycot these people"
<!--/ir-theme-->
